repository.name: @webex/plugin-memberships
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.memberships that manages Webex memberships (a person's relationship to a room) through the Webex REST API memberships resource (catalog service hydra): create POSTs a membership, get and remove take a membership object or id, list resolves a webex-core Page, and update PUTs the whole membership object, which also sets isModerator or hides a one-to-one space through isRoomHidden. listWithReadStatus({roomId}) waits for the current user and the postauth service catalog, reads the conversation with every participant's acknowledgement from the internal conversation plugin, and resolves {items} with one membership per participant carrying lastSeenId and lastSeenDate when the member has seen the space. updateLastSeen(message) sends a read receipt through the conversation acknowledge call and resolves the updated membership. listen() builds a webhook-style event envelope, connects the Mercury socket, and turns conversation activities into created, updated, deleted, and seen events on webex.memberships. Importing the package also registers the conversation and mercury internal plugins. Nothing is cached or persisted.

memberships-public-sdk.summary: Published npm package (public plugin). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js; no type declarations are published. Importing it registers the conversation and mercury internal plugins and then Memberships as public plugin 'memberships' with no config; the first registration of the name wins. The entry exports only the default Memberships class. webex.memberships exposes create, get, list, update, remove, listWithReadStatus, updateLastSeen, and listen, triggers created, updated, deleted, and seen events, and carries the JSDoc-private onWebexApiEvent and getMembershipEvent; specified in src/docs/README.md.

hydra-memberships-http.source: Webex REST API memberships resource (catalog service name hydra, reached through service: 'hydra' in src/memberships.js; route definitions are not in this repository)
hydra-memberships-http.summary: POST /memberships with a membership body; GET /memberships/<id>; GET /memberships with the caller's query object (roomId, personId, personEmail, max) answering a paged {items} with Link headers; PUT /memberships/<id> with the whole membership body; DELETE /memberships/<id> answering 204. Membership ids are base64url of ciscospark://<cluster>/MEMBERSHIP/<personUUID>:<roomUUID>.

webex-core-plugin-host.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md MOD-013, MOD-014)
webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerPlugin keys a public plugin by its raw name (memberships, first registration wins) and adds webex.<name> to later instances; WebexPlugin supplies webex, request, logger, and the ampersand event methods on, off, trigger, listenTo, and stopListening.

webex-core-page.summary: new Page(res, webex) stores the body items and parsed Link headers; next and previous request the linked URL and resolve a new Page; iteration yields items in order.

webex-core-services.source: @webex/webex-core services (no module spec coverage; code consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/lib/services/services.js)
webex-core-services.summary: waitForCatalog('postauth') resolves when the post-authentication catalog is ready, starting catalog initialization when a supertoken exists and nothing is collecting, and otherwise rejects after 60 seconds; getClusterId(url) returns the catalog cluster id of a URL.

common-hydra-ids.source: @webex/common (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/common/src/docs/README.md MOD-006, INV-001, INV-005; code consulted: packages/@webex/common/src/uuid-utils.js and constants.js)
common-hydra-ids.summary: buildHydraMembershipId encodes base64url ciscospark://<cluster>/MEMBERSHIP/<personUUID>:<spaceUUID>; buildHydraRoomId and buildHydraMessageId use the given cluster; buildHydraPersonId and buildHydraOrgId always use cluster us; getHydraClusterString maps the internal US clusters to us and throws below three cluster parts; getHydraRoomType returns direct for the ONE_ON_ONE tag, else group; deconstructHydraId decodes an id into {id, type, cluster} and throws a TypeError on undefined; SDK_EVENT holds the activity verbs, fields, tags, and external event names.

common-event-envelope.source: @webex/common createEventEnvelope and ensureMyIdIsAvailable (module spec consulted: packages/@webex/common/src/docs/README.md MOD-011; code consulted: packages/@webex/common/src/event-envelope.js)
common-event-envelope.summary: ensureMyIdIsAvailable(webex) resolves at once when webex.internal has me, else stores webex.people.get('me') as webex.internal.me and rejects when that lookup fails. createEventEnvelope(webex, resource) resolves {createdBy, orgId, resource, ownedBy: creator, status: active, created, data: {}}; when the identity lookup fails it resolves undefined instead of rejecting.

conversation-internal-sdk.source: @webex/internal-plugin-conversation (workspace package; no module spec exists; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-conversation/src/conversation.js)
conversation-internal-sdk.summary: Importing the package registers internal plugin conversation. get({id, cluster}, options) builds the conversation URL from the cluster and id, sends the options as the query (dropping its includeParticipants default when participantAckFilter is passed), rejects with an Error when no URL can be found, and resolves one conversation with id, tags, and participants.items carrying entryUUID, entryEmailAddress or entryEmail, displayName, orgId, and roomProperties. acknowledge(conversation, {id}) submits an acknowledge activity for that activity id and resolves the submitted activity with actor, object, target, and published.

mercury-activity-events.source: @webex/internal-plugin-mercury (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-mercury/src/docs/README.md MOD-001, MOD-002, MOD-009; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-mercury/src/mercury.js)
mercury-activity-events.summary: Importing the package registers internal plugin mercury. connect() shares a connect in flight and resolves at once when connected; an inbound envelope with event type conversation.activity is emitted as event:conversation.activity with data.activity; a listener error is caught and logged by _emit.
